# Pure Marketing

> Pure Marketing is a digital marketing agency based in Hamilton, Ontario, Canada. We help local service businesses get consistent, qualified leads through Google Ads, Meta Ads, lead generation, web design, social media management, and video production. No long-term contracts. Free strategy calls available.

## Services

- [Lead Generation](https://puremarketing.ca/services/lead-generation): Done-for-you lead generation using Google Ads, Meta Ads, and Local Service Ads. Clients average 40-80 qualified leads per month. From $1,499/month.
- [Google and Meta Ads](https://puremarketing.ca/services/google-meta-ads): Expert PPC advertising on Google and Facebook/Instagram. Average 5-8x ROAS. From $500/month.
- [Web Design](https://puremarketing.ca/services/web-development): Conversion-optimized custom websites for local service businesses. Mobile-first, fast-loading. Custom quoted.
- [Social Media Management](https://puremarketing.ca/services/social-media-management): Full social media management on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. From $899/month.
- [Video Production](https://puremarketing.ca/services/video-production): Professional video content including reels, brand videos, testimonials, and property tours. From $699/project.

## Industries

- [Electricians](https://puremarketing.ca/industries/electricians): Google Ads, Local Service Ads, and lead generation for electricians.
- [Plumbers](https://puremarketing.ca/industries/plumbers): Emergency call generation and lead systems for plumbers.
- [HVAC](https://puremarketing.ca/industries/hvac): Year-round lead generation for HVAC companies.
- [Painters](https://puremarketing.ca/industries/painters): Before/after content marketing and ads for painting companies.
- [General Contractors](https://puremarketing.ca/industries/general-contractors): 90-day growth system for general contractors.
- [Locksmiths](https://puremarketing.ca/industries/locksmiths): Emergency search ranking and Google Ads for locksmiths.
- [Restaurants](https://puremarketing.ca/industries/restaurants): Social media, Meta Ads, and GBP optimization for restaurants.
- [Real Estate](https://puremarketing.ca/industries/real-estate): Video marketing and listing ads for real estate agents.
- [Landscapers](https://puremarketing.ca/industries/landscapers): Seasonal marketing systems for landscaping companies.
